content: CVE-2024-45337 x/crypto/ssh PublicKeyCallback misuse: callback called for keys not proven; apps authorize on wrong key. Partial fix v0.31.0. Follow-ups 2026: CVE-2026-39828 (force-command dropped on PartialSuccess), CVE-2026-46595/56854 (source-address not enforced for non-pubkey callbacks), CVE-2026-42508 (knownhosts @revoked CA not checked), CVE-2026-39831 (FIDO UP flag unchecked); fixed v0.52.0/v0.55.0.
